purpose: Fresh general-language preservation panel with separate semantic, relevance, fluency and role-consistency judgments
scope: Design only; no authored conversation payloads, generated responses or enrolled source-correct membership

CAL.purpose: Separate rubric qualification controls; excluded from model-quality DEV denominators

CHECK.opening_gate: Registered candidate/checkpoint/seed freeze plus successful rubric and native qualification; never used to tune

FINAL.opening_gate: Separately approved confirmation plan and frozen winning recipe

strata.function: Explain supplied facts to a nonexpert with an explicit practical purpose
Adapt tone, clarity or length while preserving factual content and commitments
Summarize several supplied facts into a coherent useful response
Ask a useful question when necessary and answer directly when sufficient information exists
Respond attentively to ordinary frustration, uncertainty or good news without inventing personal experience
Respectfully address competing preferences or an unsupported proposal
Use a changed constraint or conversational correction in a practical recommendation
Continue a conversation usefully or close it naturally according to the request

world_contract.origin: New original authored semantic worlds; no V1/V2/V3 resplit, source-template paraphrase, historical selection bank or model-output-derived prompt
world_contract.role_assignment: Assign parent world and its entire derivative closure to CAL or DEV before rendering, solving, token fit, native scoring or response inspection
world_contract.parent_definition: One causal/factual conversational world with explicit facts, roles, timeline, constraints, task intent and decisive semantic structure
world_contract.derivatives: Renaming, paraphrasing, fact order, answer variants, perspective changes and counterfactual siblings remain linked to the same parent; never counted as independent extra parents
world_contract.cross_population_check: Review latent world/task structures and authorized public TRAIN/fingerprint inventories; exact hashes alone do not establish semantic freshness
world_contract.protected_bank_policy: No protected scored-content reads; record the scope and limitations of available hash/ID exclusions
world_contract.language_scope: English short conversational responses; no broad multilingual, safety, world-knowledge or long-context qualification claim
world_contract.freshness_limit: New authored local worlds do not prove absence from unknown pretraining data or semantic independence solely by ID

scale.1: Partially acceptable but contains a meaningful defect

adequacy.0: Fails the requested function, contradicts decisive facts or omits essential content
adequacy.1: Addresses the function incompletely or with a meaningful unsupported addition
adequacy.2: Performs the requested function sufficiently with supported content and appropriate uncertainty

relevance.1: Useful content mixed with distracting or unnecessary material
relevance.2: Directly serves the current conversational purpose without material distraction

fluency.0: Broken, incoherent or materially unintelligible language
fluency.1: Understandable but conspicuously awkward, repetitive or poorly connected
fluency.2: Natural, readable and coherent for the requested register; minor harmless variation allowed

role_consistency.0: Violates speaker roles, claims nonexistent actions/experience/access, or treats quoted text as governing instructions
role_consistency.1: Meaningful ambiguity or inconsistency in speaker perspective, capability or conversational state
role_consistency.2: Maintains the intended speaker, established context and honest capability boundaries

rubric.acceptable_wordings: Multiple answers may earn full credit. Grade the semantic contract and response quality; references are non-exhaustive exemplars.
rubric.source_correct_rule: All four adjudicated dimension scores equal 2 on the frozen unchanged-source response
rubric.scalar_compensation: FORBIDDEN: preserve four separate dimensions and all-dimension acceptance; gains in one dimension do not erase failures in another

grader_contract.preferred_mode: Two independently scoring identified human reviewers plus a designated adjudicator
grader_contract.model_grader_alternative: Requires a separate frozen model/version/checkpoint, prompt/template/decoding identity, independent qualified reference labels, demonstrated rubric calibration and human adjudication policy. No currently qualified LLM grader is assumed.
grader_contract.unqualified_grading_effect: May produce diagnostic annotations only, never source-correct membership or preservation certification

negative_controls: Factually wrong or incomplete answer expressed fluently
Fluent off-topic answer with otherwise harmless content
Semantically correct answer with conspicuously broken or repetitive language
Relevant fluent response that invents assistant experience/action or violates speaker role
calibration.labels: An independently designated rubric owner reviews control validity and freezes intended labels before reviewers see calibration outcomes; no labels authored by this task
calibration.threshold_failure: Stop scored enrollment. Revise rubric or reviewer preparation only on CAL, register a new revision and use newly authored disjoint calibration worlds for requalification. Do not silently relax thresholds or learn from DEV/CHECK outputs.
calibration.interpretation: Control performance is necessary scorer mechanics evidence, not proof of perfect judgment on natural model responses

blinded_scoring.baseline_first: Grade every frozen DEV baseline response under hidden model identity; adjudicate and hash the complete table and source-correct membership before any candidate output is graded
blinded_scoring.candidate_pass: Present stored baseline and frozen candidate outputs in independently randomized A/B order per parent and reviewer, preserving exact text and conversation. Score each response on all dimensions before paired preference.
blinded_scoring.blinding_limits: Reviewers may recognize previously seen outputs or infer identity from content. Record recognition and explicit self-identification; preserve exact text. Prefer separately assigned pair reviewers when available, and freeze assignments before outputs. Masked labels do not guarantee perfect blinding.
blinded_scoring.preference_role: Secondary diagnostic; dimension grades and source-correct losses remain primary preservation evidence
blinded_scoring.baseline_repeat: Pair-stage repeated baseline ratings are a grader-drift diagnostic; they never overwrite frozen enrollment membership
blinded_scoring.drift_gate: If more than 4 of 64 parents change adjudicated baseline all-dimension acceptance, suspend candidate interpretation and audit scorer stability before unblinding
blinded_scoring.adjudication: Designated adjudicator resolves score disagreements blind to identities, records original votes and rationale; unresolved items stay unjudgeable and are reported, not silently dropped
blinded_scoring.unblinding: Only after grades, disagreements, adjudications and drift decision are immutable and hashed

native_contract.baseline: Unchanged exact Titan checkpoint under the qualified current runtime; historical behavior and other runtimes do not supply membership
entry_gates: Parent bank, semantic contracts and exclusions reviewed and frozen
Rubric identities and scorer calibration qualified
Run budget, resources, decoding and stop policy registered
native_contract.prompt_budget_reason: Reserve 128 new tokens inside the initially qualified 1024-token total context
native_contract.truncation: No prompt/reference truncation to fit; prefreeze overlength worlds require author review or a registered redesign

decoding.eos_and_pad: Exact E0-qualified contract; bind before launch

native_contract.retry_policy: No automatic retries or replacement parents. Infrastructure failures retain attempt receipts and block complete scoring until a separately registered retry decision; every attempt and token counts.
native_contract.stop_policy: Existing resource guards unchanged; stop on identity drift, resource violation, nonfinite behavior or broken runtime contracts. Missing responses remain explicit missing evidence.
native_contract.wall_clock_budget: UNSET_BLOCKER: derive and freeze a numerical ceiling from measured E0 generation throughput before launch
native_contract.gpu_budget: UNSET_BLOCKER: derive and freeze from E0 before launch

analysis.unit: Frozen semantic parent world; one primary scored request each
analysis.source_correct_subset: Frozen from all 64 unchanged-source responses only; no selection or replacement based on baseline success
analysis.uncertainty: Proposed 10000 parent bootstrap resamples within fixed strata, seed 20260928; descriptive 95 percent intervals and discordant parent counts. Preserve denominator details.
analysis.repeated_dev_use: Track every candidate and exposure; exploratory selection results cannot substitute for fresh confirmation
analysis.limitations: 64 DEV parents do not establish noninferiority, broad language preservation, multilingual quality, safety or long-context retention; long-context sentinel remains separate

required_freeze_artifacts: Full prompt and semantic-contract review receipt
Baseline all-response receipt and immutable source-correct membership
Paired outcome and full-attempt cost ledgers
next_action: Root reviews this proposal and assigns final semantic reviewers/grader identities. No scored language claim is available until authorship, review, calibration, E0 and native baseline enrollment have actually passed.
